content.query:
SELECT 
    d.department_name,
    e.employee_name,
    SUM(da.planned_tasks) AS total_planned_tasks,
    SUM(da.completed_tasks) AS total_completed_tasks,
    ROUND(AVG(da.sleep_duration_hours), 2) AS avg_sleep,
    ROUND(AVG(da.productivity_score), 2) AS avg_productivity
FROM DAILY_ACTIVITY da
JOIN EMPLOYEE e 
    ON da.employee_id = e.employee_id
JOIN DEPARTMENT d 
    ON e.department_id = d.department_id
GROUP BY 
    d.department_name, 
    e.employee_name
ORDER BY 
    d.department_name, 
    avg_productivity DESC;
